invite_open: Paste the invite link from your community organizer, or open the link in your browser.
join_lead: Your invite is from {host}. Anagram reads your work on this computer. Your files and keys do not leave it.
join_lab_lead: A lab in {community}. Your invite is from {host}. Anagram reads your work on this computer. Your files and keys do not leave it.
invite_help: Your community organizer sent you this link.

again_lead: Your sign-in has ended. Your keys and findings are still on this computer.

kit_delete_note: When you continue, Anagram deletes its copy of the kit from this computer.
kit_need: Save the kit, then select “I saved my recovery kit”.
email_help: Optional. Members who know this address can find you.
code_lead: Your community server sent a code to {email}.
restore_lead: Your recovery kit opens the locked backup of your keys on your community server.

restore_need: Choose the kit file, or paste its text.
